items.q: What is Smart Wafaa and how does it work with Apple & Google Wallet?
items.a: Smart Wafaa is a native loyalty engine. You design a pass once, and customers add it to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet with a single tap. Every stamp, point or balance update is pushed to the pass instantly and signed with Apple PassKit and Google Pay certificates.

items.q: Do my customers need to download a separate mobile app?
items.a: No. Passes live inside the wallet app that already ships on every iPhone and Android device. Customers scan a QR code or tap an NFC standee and the pass is saved in under eight seconds.

items.q: Can I combine multiple mechanics on a single card?
items.a: Yes. Layer stamps, subscriptions, prepaid credit, cashback, tiers and discounts onto one pass. The rules engine resolves them at the till so staff only ever see a single customer card.

items.q: How do store staff authenticate and punch customer passes?
items.a: Each cashier gets a personal PIN on the staff terminal. They scan the customer pass with any smartphone camera or barcode scanner, and every action is logged against the staff member, customer and branch.

items.q: How does the Reseller Partner Programme work?
items.a: Agencies and POS resellers get a white-label partner portal, wholesale pricing and recurring commission on every merchant they onboard. Apply from the Partners page and our team will set up your portal within two business days.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the Smart Wafaa platform, merchant dashboard, staff terminal and wallet passes issued through it.

sections.heading: 1. The service
sections.body: Smart Wafaa provides software that lets merchants design, issue and update loyalty passes for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. We do not operate your loyalty programme; you set its rules and remain responsible for honouring rewards to your customers.

sections.heading: 2. Accounts and staff access
sections.body: You are responsible for everyone who uses your merchant account, including staff terminal PINs. Keep credentials confidential and tell us immediately about any unauthorised use.

sections.heading: 3. Subscription and billing
sections.body: Plans are billed monthly or yearly in advance and exclude VAT. You may upgrade, downgrade or cancel at any time from the dashboard; changes take effect at the next billing date unless stated otherwise.

sections.heading: 4. Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not use the service to send misleading offers, collect customer data without consent, or breach Apple's or Google's wallet platform policies. We may suspend accounts that put those platform relationships at risk.

sections.heading: 5. Customer data
sections.body: Customer data you collect through passes belongs to you. We process it on your behalf under our Privacy Policy and the applicable Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).

sections.heading: 6. Availability and support
sections.body: We aim for 99.9% monthly availability of the pass-update service. Planned maintenance is announced in advance in the dashboard.

sections.heading: 7. Liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, our total liability for any claim is limited to the fees you paid in the twelve months before the claim arose.

sections.heading: 8. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Disputes are subject to the competent courts of Riyadh.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Smart Wafaa collects, why, and the choices you have — for merchants and for the customers who hold passes.

sections.heading: 1. Data we collect from merchants
sections.body: Business name, commercial registration details, contact person, billing information and usage logs of the dashboard and staff terminal.

sections.heading: 2. Data processed for customers
sections.body: When a customer joins a programme we process the fields the merchant chooses (typically name and phone number), the pass identifier, stamp/point balances and, if the customer allows it, coarse location for lockscreen relevance. We never receive wallet payment credentials.

sections.heading: 3. How we use data
sections.body: To issue and update passes, run the rules engine, show merchants their analytics, send transactional notifications and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell personal data.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing
sections.body: Data is shared with Apple and Google only as required to deliver passes to their wallet apps, with our hosting and messaging providers under data-processing agreements, and with authorities when the law requires it.

sections.heading: 5. Retention
sections.body: Merchant data is retained for the life of the account plus the period required by Saudi commercial and tax law. Customer pass data is deleted or anonymised within 90 days of a programme being closed.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body: Under the PDPL you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, and object to certain processing. Contact us at the address in the footer.

sections.heading: 7. Security
sections.body: Passes are signed with platform certificates, data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest, and access is role-based and logged.

refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.intro: How subscription fees are refunded, and what happens to a merchant's passes if a plan is cancelled.

sections.heading: 1. Free trial
sections.body: Every new merchant account starts with a free trial. No payment method is required and nothing is charged until you choose a paid plan.

sections.heading: 2. Monthly plans
sections.body: Monthly fees are non-refundable once the billing period has started. Cancelling stops the next renewal; your programme stays live until the end of the paid period.

sections.heading: 3. Yearly plans
sections.body: You may cancel a yearly plan within 14 days of the first payment for a full refund. After 14 days, the remaining months are not refundable but you keep access until the term ends.

sections.heading: 4. Service failures
sections.body: If a verified outage of the pass-update service exceeds our availability commitment in a month, we credit that month's fee to your next invoice on request.

sections.heading: 5. Customer passes after cancellation
sections.body: Passes already in customers' wallets keep working in read-only mode for 30 days after cancellation so you can communicate the change; after that they are voided.

sections.heading: 6. How to request
sections.body: Email us from your registered account address with your merchant ID. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within 10 business days.
